notes: Seed URL works over https; results are on page/Elections.2026 and page/Elections.Archive. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Server Last-Modified values differ by file and follow the PDF creation times, so upload times are usable; a file replaced later would hide an earlier upload (the runoff SOS file was re-uploaded June 24, 2026). Following the pilot practice (Jim Hogg), a precinct report printed on election night but uploaded the next morning counts as LATER. Check 3 (Wayback) pending: origin/wayback-data not present, so earlier election-night uploads that were later replaced cannot be ruled out. 2024_general.fact: Rule 43: no election-night county-totals-only file survives (earliest upload 2024-11-06 08:35 CT (upload); the county-totals SOS report (UnofficialResults.pdf, CreationDate 2024-11-06 04:31 UTC = 10:31 PM CST Nov 5) is matched by the precinct report ('Unofficial results report by Pct', printed footer 'Precinct Summary - 11/05/2024 9:55 PM', per-precinct Election Day votes, e.g. Precinct 1 Trump 181 / Harris 135), and both were uploaded the next morning (8:35 and 10:36 AM CST Nov 6), so nothing shows county totals alone that night). Previous: Past Elections, November 2024: 'Unofficial Results' = SOS 'Election Unofficial Results Report' (county totals), PDF CreationDate Wed Nov 6 04:31:10 2024 UTC (10:31 PM CST Nov 5), Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 14:35:15 GMT (8:35 AM CST Nov 6). 'Unofficial Results by Precinct' = 84-page scan (Konica Minolta), CreationDate Wed Nov 6 15:22:45 2024 UTC, Last-Modified Wed, 06 Nov 2024 16:36:02 GMT (10:36 AM CST Nov 6). Both uploaded after election night.
